paper_record.title: Metallic electron crystals in rhombohedral graphene as a bridge to twisted WSe$_2$
paper_record.abstract: Superconducting phases have recently been discovered both in twisted bilayers of transition metal dichalcogenide WSe$_2$ (tWSe$_2$) and in rhombohedral multilayer graphene (RMG). While both have generated extensive interest, they appear to be driven by qualitatively different physics. Here, we propose a unified picture in which the superconductivity in RMG arises from a strongly correlated metallic state with a spatial length scale that is compatible with the moiré length scale of tWSe$_2$. Central to this mechanism is a Wigner crystal phase in RMG that is metallic, driven by a "W"-shaped dispersion in the flat part of the underlying graphene band structure. We demonstrate this effect through calculations of Wigner crystal states in pentalayer RMG, focusing on dilute electrons in the quarter-metal regime relevant to experiment. In a region of the phase diagram we find the Wigner crystal breaks three-fold rotation symmetry, which guides our construction of a $t$-$V$ model on a triangular lattice as an effective description of the low-energy electronic physics. This construction suggests a surprisingly similar low-energy description of RMG and tWSe$_2$. Broader implications for superconductivity in dilute carrier systems are also discussed.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文提出了一种通过在菱方多层石墨烯中形成金属态维格纳晶体来统一解释其与扭转过渡金属硫化物超导机制的理论框架。
one_sentence_summary.en: This paper proposes a unified theoretical framework linking superconductivity in rhombohedral multilayer graphene and twisted transition metal dichalcogenides through metallic Wigner crystal states.

problem.zh: 尽管菱方多层石墨烯和扭转过渡金属硫化物都展现出由静电调控的超导相，但它们通常被认为由截然不同的物理机制驱动（且石墨烯中缺乏莫尔势），缺乏一个统一的理论框架来连接这两类系统的低能电子物理。
problem.en: Although both rhombohedral multilayer graphene and twisted transition metal dichalcogenides host superconductivity, they are typically viewed as driven by distinct physics and lack a unified framework connecting their low-energy electronic properties.

approach.zh: 利用十带连续模型结合自洽哈特里-Fock方法，研究了五层菱方石墨烯在稀薄载流子极限下的库仑相互作用与原子尺度晶格势（形成“W”型色散）的相互作用，并在三角晶格上构建了有效的 t-V 模型。
approach.en: Using a ten-band continuum model and self-consistent Hartree-Fock calculations, the authors study the interplay between Coulomb interactions and the 'W'-shaped band dispersion in pentalayer rhombohedral graphene, and construct an effective t-V model on a triangular lattice.

main_takeaway.zh: 菱方多层石墨烯在底带“W”型色散和长程库仑相互作用下会自发形成金属态维格纳晶体，其破缺的三重旋转对称性和重构的费米面为理解其与扭转过渡金属硫化物超导机制的共性提供了桥梁。
main_takeaway.en: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene spontaneously forms metallic Wigner crystals driven by the 'W'-shaped dispersion and Coulomb interactions, providing a bridge to the superconductivity mechanisms of moire transition metal dichalcogenides through C3z symmetry breaking and Fermi surface reconstruction.

why_it_matters.zh: 该工作揭示了由长程库仑排斥和原子尺度周期性共同驱动的金属维格纳晶体相，成功将菱方多层石墨烯的关联电子态与莫尔超导系统联系起来，为稀薄载流子系统中的非常规超导提供了一条新的统一路线。
why_it_matters.en: This work uncovers a metallic Wigner crystal phase driven by long-range Coulomb repulsion and atomic periodicity, bridging rhombohedral graphene and moire superconductors and offering a unified perspective on unconventional superconductivity in dilute carrier systems.

reason.zh: 该研究建立了一个强有力的理论桥梁，将两种备受关注的二维超导平台（石墨烯与莫尔过渡金属硫化物）在金属维格纳晶体和有效晶格模型框架下统一起来。
reason.en: The study establishes a powerful theoretical bridge uniting two prominent 2D superconducting platforms—graphene and moire transition metal dichalcogenides—within a metallic Wigner crystal and effective lattice model framework.

reason.zh: 该论文结合了复杂的微观自洽哈特里-Fock计算与有效格点模型分析，解决了当前凝聚态物理中关于二维多层石墨烯与莫尔超导关联的前沿热点问题，符合该期刊的标准。
reason.en: The paper combines sophisticated microscopic self-consistent Hartree-Fock calculations with effective lattice model analysis to address a cutting-edge topic in correlated 2D materials, fitting the scope of PRX.
